ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #20
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Transporting? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Transporting.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Transporting.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Transporting.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Transporting.

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Energy: Light its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Energy: Light its resources.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Energy: Light its resources.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Energy: Light its resources.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Energy: Light its resources.

3. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Paper burning to ash
   B. Ice melting to water
   C. Milk souring
   D. Iron rusting

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Weather its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Weather its resources.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Weather its resources.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Weather its resources.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Weather its resources.

5. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water removes heat too quickly
   B. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   C. Water always increases oxygen
   D. Petrol fires have no fuel

6. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   B. Overgrazing continuously
   C. Removing all vegetation
   D. Burning crop residue every week

7. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Decomposers only
   B. Producers
   C. Tertiary consumers
   D. Primary consumers only

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Animals resources? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Animals resources.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Animals resources.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Animals resources.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animals resources.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Precautions when using? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Precautions when using.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Precautions when using.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Precautions when using.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Precautions when using.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying School environment environment? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on School environment environment.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about School environment environment.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to School environment environment.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for School environment environment.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Safety when handling? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Safety when handling.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Safety when handling.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Safety when handling.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Safety when handling.

12. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any substance that conducts electricity
   B. Any white crystal used in cooking
   C. A mixture of two liquids
   D. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water its resources.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Water its resources.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water its resources.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water its resources.

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Forming shadows in light? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Forming shadows in light.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Forming shadows in light.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Forming shadows in light.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Forming shadows in light.

15. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Glucose and oxygen
   C. Nitrogen gas only
   D. Only water vapour

16. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 37 °C
   B. 50 °C
   C. 100 °C
   D. 0 °C

17. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   B. Heating until a solid melts
   C. A chemical reaction forming ash
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

18. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Recording weather? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Recording weather.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Recording weather.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Recording weather.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Recording weather.

19. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Interpreting? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Interpreting.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Interpreting.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Interpreting.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Interpreting.

20. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Soil and its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Soil and its resources.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Soil and its resources.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Soil and its resources.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Soil and its resources.

21. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   B. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   C. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   D. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya

22. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. joule (J)
   B. newton (N)
   C. watt (W)
   D. pascal (Pa)

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
23. In three clear sentences, explain Recording weather and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Interpreting and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

25. In three clear sentences, explain Water its resources and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

26. In three clear sentences, explain Transporting and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

27. In three clear sentences, explain Soil and its resources and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

28. In three clear sentences, explain Animals resources and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

29. In three clear sentences, explain Safety when handling and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

30. In three clear sentences, explain Energy: Light its resources and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

31. In three clear sentences, explain Forming shadows in light and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

32. In three clear sentences, explain Precautions when using and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
